lede: Denver Broncos carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#17 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Arizona Cardinals +4.0 with a fair total of 44.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Arizona Cardinals pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.208 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
